description: The agent must: (1) Read the SKILL.md for the meeting-note workflow and discover all proprietary constraints without being told. (2) Parse the raw messy transcript to identify: meeting type=决策会, level=L2 (project, NOT L3 so no expert roundtable required), participants with roles. (3) Apply Step 1 to fill basic info, using TBD for any unconfirmed fields (e.g., Q3 timeline). (4) Apply Step 3 per-topic structure with ✅/⏳/❓ decision status markers — the main architecture direction is ✅, Q3 timeline is ⏳ pending Fangyi's report, risk modeling talent is ❓ unresolved. (5) Apply Step 4 hidden content analysis with explicit '推测依据' evidence for unstated assumptions (e.g., Lin's real concern about team capability, power dynamics). (6) Apply Step 4 to produce all 3 atom types: 决策原子, 洞察原子, 假设/风险原子. (7) Apply Step 5 to produce 🔴🟡🟢 priority-coded action items with verb-start, measurable success criteria, responsible person (方怡's evaluation report 🔴 this week, 陈国强's checklist 🟡 within 2 weeks, 林晓薇's talent discussion 🟢), and TBD for unconfirmed deadlines. (8) Include ≥2 [[双向链接]] Zettelkasten connections using [[filename]] syntax linking to existing knowledge nodes. (9) Include risk section covering data residency risk (数据出境/数据安全法) AND vendor dependency risk (SLA/停服备案) with mitigation suggestions. (10) Correctly identify this as L2 (NOT L3) and therefore NOT trigger 专家圆桌 as mandatory.
